title: THE CONTAINER PROOF — the gi-consumption probe in a HEADED OMP TUI

auth_probe.required: a model-backed call must succeed (the silent-auth-failure green is the #1 false-green)
auth_probe.result: PASS — the model answered and drove a tool call

scenarios.name: the tool is REGISTERED and CALLABLE
scenarios.action: natural-language prompt: 'Call the gi-consumption tool with no arguments'

scenarios.name: the ABSENT-SUBSTRATE path is a LOUD named failure (never a fabricated green)
scenarios.observed: consumed:0/8 rungs=none  (every consumer DOWN with its evidence)
scenarios.verdict: PASS — the no-fallback law holds in the runtime

scenarios.name: the REAL stores produce REAL facts through the REAL tool
scenarios.action: gi-consumption subject=populateSessionStore scopeRoot=/root/gi-scope (the live stores copied in)
scenarios.observed: L5_CORBELL CONSUMED rung=settlement facts=16; L6_GRAPHIFY CONSUMED rung=settlement facts=8

scenarios.name: THE RUNGS ARE THE DESIGNED RUNGS (the rung assertion)
scenarios.pass_token: rung=settlement rung=context rung=knowledge rung=decision rung=meaning rung=repair
scenarios.observed: L5/L6=settlement · L4/L3=context · L2=knowledge · L1=decision · TSG=meaning · ABIDE=repair
scenarios.verdict: PASS — matches the DPL1 layer→rung map exactly

scenarios.name: THE ENVIRONMENT HONESTY (the same probe, two environments)
scenarios.observed: host: L2_ARSUMBRIS=GI_LAYER_UNCONSUMED (2 live sockets present). container: L2_ARSUMBRIS=GI_LAYER_DOWN (no ~/.arsumbris).
scenarios.verdict: PASS — the probe reports its OWN environment, never a canned answer

scenarios.name: THE DECISION RUNS IN THE ARTIFACT (gi-decide mounted and executed)
scenarios.action: natural-language prompt: 'Call the gi-decide tool with subject evidence and scopeRoot /root/gi-scope. Report its raw output verbatim.'

scenarios.name: THE LAYER-EDGE — the kernel's layer declarations come FROM THE REGISTRY
scenarios.action: the same gi-decide call; read layersWired
scenarios.observed: layersWired=6/8 — the 6 graph layers out of the closed set of 8

scenarios.name: THE STALE STORE IS REFUSED — no fact is served from it (M-GRAPH-3)
scenarios.action: the same call; read the graph rung
scenarios.observed: M-GRAPH-3   settles=true   action=IGNORE   the graph store is STALE — no fact is served from it

scenarios.name: THE LEDGER IS WRITTEN — the kernel's RECORD stage (6) fires
scenarios.action: the same call; read the RECORD stage + the ledger file

scenarios.name: A NAMED REFUSAL, NEVER A SILENT PASS (GI_STACK_INCOMPLETE)
scenarios.action: the same call; read the verdict + code
scenarios.observed: verdict=REFUSE   class=benign   code=GI_STACK_INCOMPLETE:L4_C2KG — every absent substrate NAMED by exact path

scenarios.name: THE FRESH SCOPE CREATES ITS LEDGER (a decision never fails on its record)
scenarios.action: gi-decide with scopeRoot /tmp (a scope that never hosted the kernel)
scenarios.observed: BEFORE the fix: GI_DECIDE_FAILED: GI_LEDGER_OPEN_FAILED: cannot open or migrate the fire ledger at /tmp/.omp/graph-intelligence/fire-decisions.db (unable to open database file). AFTER: verdict=REFUSE class=benign code=GI_STACK_INCOMPLETE:L5_CORBELL with the ledger created

scenarios.name: THE NEGATIVE PATH — a legit query answers with ZERO misfire
scenarios.action: natural-language prompt: 'Call graph-query with subject ThisSymbolDoesNotExistXYZ'
scenarios.observed: graph-query returned its schema + executed — no misfire, no crash

scenarios.name: THE A3 STORE-AGE GATE — a stale store THROWS, never serves (GI_LAYER_ERROR)
scenarios.action: gi-consumption with subject evidence; read L5/L6
scenarios.observed: L5_CORBELL   GI_LAYER_ERROR:L5_CORBELL  rung=settlement  facts=0 · L6_GRAPHIFY   GI_LAYER_ERROR:L6_GRAPHIFY — the stale store THROWS (the A3 fix firing in the container)

scenarios.name: THE DIST-CONTENT GATE INSIDE THE RIG — every kernel symbol present
scenarios.observed: runKernelV2=2 FireLedger=2 PolicyStore=2 graphFacts=2 decideFromRegistry=2 decideFireFromGraph=2 gi-decide=3

theatrical_finding.class: AGENT-PROSE DIVERGENCE (the model's summary, not the tool)
theatrical_finding.detail: The model's prose listed 'L3_UA rung=knowledge' while the TOOL RESULT printed 'L3_UA rung=context'. The source rung map is correct (adapters/ua.ts:20 rung:'context').
theatrical_finding.law: This is the pin's own law demonstrated live: a claim in agent prose is NOT evidence. The tool result is. No code change; recorded as evidence of why the PROOF CONTRACT binds tokens to tool results.

verdict: E-2 PASS — 14/14 scenarios; the deploy sha matches; the tool produced REAL facts and REAL refusals in a HEADED OMP TUI
kernel_note: ★ SC-6..SC-14 were driven AFTER the F-98 fix (the kernel VALUE-wired into the dist) and AFTER the F-96 corbell scope fix. The container carries ONLY L5/L6 substrates and is a minimal environment (no corbell, no java, no pnpm, a 1-file project tree) — so the kernel's REFUSE is the CORRECT answer to the container's real state, not a defect. SC-5 (the environment honesty) is the same probe in two environments.
